Here's the latest in trending:Slowing growth: Netflix (NFLX) falls as results disappoint; Sarandos says 'we could do better.'Strong AI demand: Supermicro (SMCI) surges after raising revenue guidance well past estimates.Kyiv blindsided: Elon Musk ordered Starlink (SPCX) slowdown that disrupted Ukraine's defenses.

 Good morning! Here's the latest in trending: 

 Slowing growth:  Netflix ( NFLX ) falls as results disappoint ; Sarandos says 'we could do better.' 

 Strong AI demand:  Supermicro ( SMCI ) surges after raising revenue guidance  well past estimates. 

 Kyiv blindsided:  Elon Musk ordered Starlink ( SPCX ) slowdown that disrupted Ukraine's defenses .

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Top News
 
 
 
 Weighing merger 
 
 
 
Getty Images
 
 
 Elon Musk has backed the idea of a SpaceX ( SPCX )-Tesla ( TSLA ) combination, fueling expectations of the largest ever corporate merger becoming a reality. The companies have established special committees consisting of independent directors to evaluate a merger that could create a $3.5T combined entity.

 Zoom in: "I think some people out there assume that a SpaceX and Tesla merger is a certainty," Musk said during an earnings call with analysts. "And I think that would be overstating it. Do I think it would be a good idea, yes. But at the end of the day, the shareholders have to be supportive of this. And particularly on the Tesla side, we will need a 50% vote of all shareholders." He believes there's a lot of merit to combining the companies. "There's a lot to be gained from cooperating on developing super intelligent software, chip design, the Terafab, obviously, robotics, mass to orbit with the Starmind constellation," Musk pointed out. But he clarified that since he's a  conflicted party , he can't be a part of the special committees' discussions on the matter. "It's an odd kabuki dance where two groups of people are talking, and I can't be in the conversation." 

 Bigger picture:  A potential merger of two of Musk's most prominent companies could reshape their valuations, capital allocation strategies and exposure to AI. Combining SpaceX's satellite communications and aerospace operations with Tesla's autonomous driving technology, robotics and AI development could create opportunities for technological collaboration. But the financial terms, corporate structure and regulatory implications of any transaction remain uncertain. SA analyst Brett Ashcroft Green stated that SpaceX has more growth avenues than Tesla, because of which he thinks a merger is likely. "While it may hurt SpaceX multiples and growth rates in the near term [especially if Tesla shares require a premium to merge], Tesla also brings liquidity along with it, with a very healthy, cash-rich balance sheet," Green added. 

 Earnings update: Shares of SpaceX ( SPCX ) are up 9% before the bell this morning after the possible merger update and its stellar Q3 results that exceeded expectations. The company's Super Intelligence segment accounted for more than half of its quarterly revenue, driven by new cloud services agreements, the Cursor acquisition, and increased adoption of Grok among enterprise customers and consumers. "Revenue grew an impressive 161% Y/Y, fueled by continued momentum in Connectivity and a clear inflection in our Super Intelligence business," CFO Bret Johnsen noted. "The combination of our launch leadership, recurring Starlink revenue, and the significant expansion of our Super Intelligence infrastructure continues to drive meaningful operating leverage." With Tesla slated to report its earnings after hours today, here's what to expect .

U.S. Navy stops buying Aevex ( AVEX ) drone boats due to technical issues .

Trump promises farmer bailout, cash payments ahead of midterm elections .

 In Asia, Japan +0.9% . Hong Kong -0.9% . China -0.6% . India -0.2% .
 In Europe, at midday, London flat. Paris +0.5% . Frankfurt +0.6% .
 Futu res at 6:30, Dow -0.1% . S&P +0.1% . Nasdaq +0.3% . Crude +2.4% to $100.12. Gold -0.2% to $4,133.70. Bitcoin +2.2% to $83,258.
